_NOTE: Managed by Home Manager via ~/.dotfiles/config/claude/settings.json. On "home-manager switch" this file is MERGED into ~/.claude/settings.json, not copied over it: keys listed as enforced in modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix (_NOTE, env, hooks, model, permissions, statusLine) are forced back to the values here, and every other key keeps whatever the live file has. So settings you change interactively via /config now survive rebuilds, while the repo still owns system behaviour. Values here for non-enforced keys are seeds for a fresh machine.

env._MODEL_NOTE: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL are the single source of truth for the default Opus/Sonnet models. Do not set them elsewhere (e.g. packages/claude-code.nix wrapper).
env._MAX_OUTPUT_NOTE: 128000 is the model ceiling for Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.x; Claude Code's own default is 64000. Haiku 4.5 caps at 64000, so a Haiku subagent may reject this value.

hooks.command: SESSION_ID=$(jq -r '.session_id // "default"'); for f in /tmp/claude-inhibitor-*.pid; do [ -f "$f" ] && ! kill -0 "$(cat "$f")" 2>/dev/null && rm -f "$f"; done; systemd-inhibit --what=sleep --who=claude-code --why="Claude Code session" --mode=block tail --pid=$PPID -f /dev/null & echo $! > /tmp/claude-inhibitor-${SESSION_ID}.pid
